title: Rahab
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story 
we hear about a lady that was not an Israelite
BUT SHE KNEW WHO THE LORD WAS

She lived in the promised land in a town called Jericho.
Joshua sent 2 spies to check out the promised land and Jericho.
Rahab welcomed Joshua’s spies and she hid them from the Kings men.

She hid the 2 spies on her roof under some grass.
But she said something that was AMAZING!
She told them that her people had been scared of the Israelites ever since God opened the Red Sea 
for them to cross over 40 years ago!
She said that she knew their Lord was the God of heaven and earth.
RAHAB HAD FAITH IN GOD!
Download, print and colour in - can you spot the spies?

Talk to Jesus
Dear Jesus
Thank you for saving me
Please make me strong and courageous
Amen
